summary: Munzingen-born mason in Basel; possibly Servatius's brother or half-brother (speculative).
bio: Illegitimate son of Walburga Birkenberger, b. 1808 Munzingen, master mason in Basel (GEDBAS). The Munzingen 1844 death register (No. 11) copies a certified extract of the death in Basel on 1 Apr 1844 of Agatha Carolina Birkenmeyer (b. 28 Jan 1838), daughter of Johann Birkenmeyer of Munzingen and Carolina Belinger[?].
sources: Landesarchiv Baden-Württemberg, Staatsarchiv Freiburg, L 10 Nr. 1591 (Munzingen, Catholic parish, Standesbücher 1840–1870; 631 images; record id 5-480947), deaths 1844 No. 11 http://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=5-480947-125
